name: Sonix
description: Audio-reactive WebGL music visualizer. An npm-workspaces monorepo (shared/backend/frontend): an Express 5 API serves a React SPA, persists data in MongoDB (Mongoose) with images/shaders in GridFS, and authenticates via a JWT carried in a signed httpOnly cookie. The browser captures microphone audio, runs an FFT, and feeds the frequency data into a three.js GLSL shader rendered on a canvas.

nodes.label: Listener
nodes.detail: Person in a browser who logs in, browses and plays audio-reactive visualizers.

nodes.label: SPA Shell
nodes.detail: React Router routes; wrapped by AuthProvider + ToastProvider in main.tsx.

nodes.label: AuthProvider
nodes.detail: Bootstraps session via GET /users/user; exposes login/register/logout/updateProfile; gates Protected/Guest routes.

nodes.label: Login / SignUp
nodes.detail: Credential forms; calls AuthProvider.login / register.

nodes.label: Explore Page
nodes.detail: Paginated, searchable, tag-filtered grid of visualizer cards; save/unsave favorites.

nodes.label: Player Page
nodes.detail: Full-screen player for /visualizer/:id (protected); wires GLSL + mic audio + WebGL.

nodes.label: Settings Page
nodes.detail: Profile, password, avatar upload, account delete.

nodes.label: apiFetch client
nodes.detail: fetch wrapper with credentials:'include'; typed via @sonix/shared ApiEndpoints.

nodes.label: GLSL Loader + Cache
nodes.detail: Fetches visualizer GLSL (or demo), de-dupes in-flight requests, caches shader source. Consumed by usePlayerGlsl.ts.

nodes.label: Audio Analyzer
nodes.detail: getUserMedia → AudioContext → AnalyserNode (FFT 256); getAudioData() returns Uint8Array of frequency bins.

nodes.label: WebGL Renderer
nodes.detail: three.js ShaderMaterial (fragmentShader = visualizer.glsl); requestAnimationFrame loop uploads audio Uint8Array into uAudio DataTexture.

nodes.label: Express App
nodes.detail: Middleware chain: rate-limit, json, helmet, cors(credentials), cookieParser(JWT_SECRET), morgan; mounts /api/v1 routers; serves built SPA from frontend/dist.

nodes.label: Auth Route
nodes.detail: POST register/login/logout (controllers/auth.ts); per-route authLimiter.

nodes.label: Visualizer Route
nodes.detail: GET / (list, public), /demo, /tags; GET /:id (full incl glsl, auth required). controllers/visualizer.ts.

nodes.label: User Route
nodes.detail: All authenticated. Profile get/patch/delete, password, GET collection, POST/DELETE visuals/:id. controllers/user.ts.

nodes.label: Images Route
nodes.detail: POST/DELETE user avatar (auth+multer), GET users/:id and visualizers/:id (public stream). controllers/images.ts.

nodes.label: auth middleware
nodes.detail: Reads req.signedCookies.token, jwt.verify with JWT_SECRET, sets req.user; throws UnauthenticatedError otherwise.

nodes.label: upload middleware
nodes.detail: multer memoryStorage, 5MB limit, image mime-type filter (utils/imageValidation.ts).

nodes.label: JWT util
nodes.detail: createJWT (sign w/ JWT_LIFETIME) + attachCookiesToResponse (httpOnly, signed, sameSite strict).

nodes.label: GridFS util / imageStorage
nodes.detail: upload/delete/openDownloadStream over GridFSBucket; wrapped by services/imageStorage.ts. Buckets: images, shaders.

nodes.label: users
nodes.detail: name, email(unique), bcrypt password (pre-save hash), image ref; comparePassword + createJWT methods.

nodes.label: visualizers
nodes.detail: name, source, glsl (shader src), imageUrl ref, isDemo, tags[]. Seeded by scripts/seedVisualizers.ts.

nodes.label: uservisuals
nodes.detail: userId + visualizerId join (unique compound index) = saved favorites.

nodes.label: images
nodes.detail: ownerType(user|visualizer)+ownerId (unique), fileId → GridFS, filename, contentType, size.

nodes.label: GridFS buckets
nodes.detail: Binary file storage for avatars / visualizer images inside MongoDB.

nodes.label: MongoDB Atlas
nodes.detail: Mongoose connection; sole datastore (collections + GridFS).

nodes.label: Web Audio / MediaDevices
nodes.detail: navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia + AudioContext/AnalyserNode — live microphone capture + FFT.

nodes.label: Render
nodes.detail: Hosts the single Node web service (build → npm start), health check /api/v1/health, autoDeploy from dev.

flows.name: Play visualizer (audio → GLSL → GPU)
flows.description: Load a visualizer's GLSL, capture mic audio, FFT it, and drive the three.js fragment shader every frame.

steps.label: render to canvas
steps.detail: requestAnimationFrame loop; uTime + uResolution + uAudio uniforms

flows.name: Log in
flows.description: Authenticate credentials and receive a JWT in a signed httpOnly cookie.

steps.label: Set-Cookie token
steps.detail: httpOnly, signed, sameSite:strict, secure in prod

flows.name: Browse / Explore
flows.description: Paginated, searchable, tag-filtered list of visualizers (glsl field excluded).

steps.label: find(filter).select(-glsl).skip.limit + countDocuments
steps.detail: page≤default, limit cap 50, $regex name, tag match

flows.name: Save favorite
flows.description: Add a visualizer to the signed-in user's collection.

flows.name: Upload avatar
flows.description: Store a user image in GridFS and link it on the User document.

flows.name: Serve image
flows.description: Stream a visualizer/user image binary out of GridFS to an tag (public).

meta.notes: Verified against the repo at the above commit. The unused PostgreSQL scaffold (backend/src/config/db.postgres.js + the 'pg' dependency) is intentionally omitted — server.ts connects only to MongoDB. AuthProvider.tsx calls fetch directly rather than through api/client.ts; both are modeled as the same client→server hop. Default flow is 'play-visualizer'.
